title: GraphSmith Host Adapter
description: Contract every Lane D (canonical-to-surfaces generator) adapter implements. An adapter takes GraphSmith's canonical skill definition (repo root SKILL.md) and renders it for one specific agent host. Frozen in v0.5.0 Wave 0 -- see .plans/v0.5.0/WAVE-0-CANONICAL-SOURCE.md for the decision this formalizes.

id.description: Stable adapter identifier, e.g. 'cursor', 'copilot', 'agents-generic'. Matches the directory/file name under generators/adapters/.

displayName.description: Human-readable host name for docs and CLI output, e.g. 'Cursor'.

targetPath.description: Repo-relative path this adapter's output goes to in an installed project, e.g. '.cursor/rules/graphsmith.mdc' or 'AGENTS.md'.

placementMode.description: 'standalone': the generator owns this file outright and may overwrite it wholesale on every regeneration -- safe only when the file is exclusively GraphSmith's (e.g. a dedicated file inside a rules directory that tolerates multiple files, like .cursor/rules/graphsmith.mdc). 'reconciled': the target file may already contain a user's own unrelated content (e.g. AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) -- the generator's rendered output for this adapter MUST be handed to Lane A's reconciler and never written directly. Getting this wrong on a single-file surface is a data-loss bug, not a cosmetic one.

outputFormat.description: 'markdown-frontmatter': host expects a YAML frontmatter block (see frontmatterFields) followed by a markdown body. 'markdown-plain': host expects plain markdown with no frontmatter block (the frontmatter, if any, is stripped before writing).

frontmatterFields.description: Only present when outputFormat is 'markdown-frontmatter'. Defines how this host's frontmatter fields map from canonical SKILL.md's frontmatter.

name.description: Frontmatter key this host expects, e.g. 'description', 'globs', 'alwaysApply'.

source.description: Either a canonical SKILL.md frontmatter field name to copy/adapt from (e.g. 'description'), or the literal string 'static' meaning this adapter supplies a fixed, host-specific value via staticValue.

maxLength.description: Optional hard cap this host's field enforces (e.g. a host whose UI truncates long descriptions).

bodyTransform.description: How the canonical SKILL.md body maps to this surface's body. Only 'verbatim' (copy the body unchanged, ponytail's build-openclaw-skills.js pattern) is defined for v0.5.0 -- GraphSmith's canonical source has no lite/full/ultra mode split the way ponytail's does, so no mode-filtering transform exists yet. If a future need for per-host body variation appears, extend this enum then; do not build a speculative filtering mechanism now with nothing to filter.

generatedFileHeader.description: A short comment inserted at the top of standalone-mode output, identifying the file as machine-generated, naming the canonical source (SKILL.md) it was rendered from, and warning against hand-editing (a direct edit will be silently overwritten on the next generation run and is exactly the failure mode Lane D's adversarial tests check for). Not used for reconciled-mode output, which is delimited by Lane A's own markers instead.
